内置官方轨道，超出有效期不外推。太阳位置按天文历表计算；地球为平均半径球体。整站: Bundled official ephemerides are not extrapolated beyond their validity. Solar position uses astronomical ephemerides; Earth is a mean-radius sphere. Station attitude assumes along-track flight with nadir pointing. Array angles are simulated, not telemetry. Independent Xuntian is a same-orbit illustration.
星点方向来自 J2000 星表，不随地球自转。摄影风格仅作曝光近似。云图为静态合: Star directions use a fixed J2000 catalogue. Photo style approximates exposure. Clouds are a static composite, not current weather. Ground tracks show approximately one orbit centered on the selected time.
各接口独立选择，可重复部署同型飞船；太阳翼按位置分别控制。自选组合可能产生几何重: Choose each port independently, including duplicate spacecraft. Arrays are controlled per instance. Custom assemblies may overlap.
自动按各实例转轴寻优；遮挡使用采样估计。转速暂设 3°/模拟秒，跳转时间直接重算: Optimize each instance within its rotation axes; estimate occlusion by sampling. Slew rate is 3° per simulated second. Time jumps recompute angles directly. Manual adjustment disables auto-tracking.
整组转动带动尾部转架及双翼；翼板自转只改变翼面朝向。角度为可视化演示，不代表实物: Assembly roll rotates the rear frame and both arrays; array pitch changes panel orientation. Angles are illustrative, not actual mechanical limits.
所有问天、梦天实例按对应转轴联动；反向轴使用相反角度，非平行轴不保证翼面平行。: All Wentian/Mengtian instances follow their corresponding axes. Reversed axes use opposite angles; nonparallel axes may not yield parallel panels.
翼板绕根部横向转轴旋转。此实例的角度可独立控制。: The array rotates about its transverse root axis. This instance can be controlled independently.

各接口可重复部署任意舱体。新增天和使用尾口接入，四个节点接口可继续扩展；左侧按核: Deploy any module type at each port, including duplicates. New Tianhe cores connect aft-first and expose four node ports for further expansion. Cores are numbered in this list. Arrays remain independent; custom assemblies may overlap.
内置官方轨道，超出有效期不外推。太阳位置按天文历表计算；地球为平均半径球体。整站: The bundled official ephemeris is not extrapolated beyond its validity interval. The Sun uses astronomical ephemerides and Earth is a mean-radius sphere. The station front follows the ground track with Earth rotation included, and its ventral side faces Earth. Attitude and array angles are simulated, not telemetry. The independent Xuntian is only an illustrative companion in the same orbit.
相同种子与模拟时间可复现；本地云系与光幕随时间连续变化，暂停时静止。极光网格是预: The same seed and simulation time reproduce the scene. Generated weather freezes when paused. Aurora grids are forecasts; curtains are illustrative. Polar clouds are filled and coverage can have gaps.
保存时间、曝光、种子、数据选择和视角；不改变舱体组合。历史快照请同时收藏，避免缓: Preserves time, exposure, seed, data selection and camera; keeps the assembly unchanged. Favorite the referenced data snapshots to protect them from cache cleanup.
仅点击更新时联网。失败保留旧数据；观测时间未知时只显示下载时间。内置素材随软件更: Network access only when updating. Failed updates retain existing data. Unknown observation times are not inferred from downloads. Bundled assets update with the app. Use the local launcher for the official orbit relay, or import orbit files manually.

体积云沿视线计算厚度与内部散射。卫星图控制覆盖，云高、内部结构及漂移为模拟；数据: Ray marching models cloud depth and scattering. Satellite imagery supplies coverage; height, structure and motion are illustrative. Data-driven drift is bounded to ±6 hours of the snapshot.
